source: Validated local builds from preserved project source; not downloaded or claimed as published registry versions.

packaging.strategy: Exact manifest versions; checkout lock resolves integrity-checked vendor tarballs. pack:portable compiles a fresh staging directory and bundles installed locked runtime closure except root @cardano-sdk/core and @aiken-lang/merkle-patricia-forestry, which remain normal shared registry dependencies.
packaging.limitation: Other bundled runtime libraries and internal Cardano versions may duplicate consumer libraries. Outer protocol integrity covers the bundle; consumer lock has no separate integrity for embedded packages.
